title: Professional Certificate Course in Marketing Research Process
description: Unravel the art of strategic decision-making through the indispensable framework of marketing research process.
longDescription: Marketing Research. Types of Marketing Research. Marketing Research Methods. Importance of Market Research. The Key Aspects of Market Research. Marketing Research Process. Marketing Research Principles & Ethics. Marketing Research Examples. The aim of this course is to equip learners with the knowledge and skills to conduct effective marketing research, while the second aim is to develop their ability to critically evaluate research findings and make informed decisions based on them. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following,
courseDetails: This course aims to provide learners with a comprehensive understanding of marketing research, including the different types and methods, the importance of market research, the key aspects involved in the research process, and the principles and ethics that should be followed. It also aims to provide practical examples that showcase the use of marketing research in real-world situations.
